_comment: Every Hopover option, with its default. Options live in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Hopover\options.json (on Linux, ~/.config/hopover/options.json); a config.json in the data folder is read too, and options.json wins key by key. Script parameters win over both. Every key is optional except migrationRoot (needed by Backup-Extras.ps1 and Save-Drivers.ps1). Paths can use %ENVVARS% and ~.
_devRoot: Folder holding your git checkouts. Exported, checked for unpushed work, and re-cloned on the new PC.
_useOnlyRepos: Repos (relative to devRoot) you only use, never push. Their local changes aren't reported or archived, e.g. "tools\\some-upstream-project".
_migrationRoot: A folder on a drive that won't be wiped (an external drive is best). Backup-Extras.ps1 writes extras\ here, Save-Drivers.ps1 writes drivers\, and New-Backup.ps1 saves a Backup here unless given -Destination.
_wipedDrives: Drive letters the reinstall will erase. The Windows drive always counts as wiped, listed or not. Test-WipeReady.ps1 fails when every copy of the Backup is on one of them.
_excludedTypeRoots: Folders on drives being wiped to search for files that cloud backups usually skip (.exe, .msi, .dll, .iso...). Leave out game libraries; they redownload.
_portableRoots: Where Catalog-InstalledApps.ps1 looks for portable apps (.exe files outside Program Files).
_appData: Backup-Extras.ps1 archives the app data of every app in catalog\app-data.json that it finds. include adds optional entries (wildcards, e.g. "app-thunderbird-*"), exclude drops entries, custom adds your own. Paths may use * and ?: (any drive letter).
_backup: The cloud backup service Test-WipeReady.ps1 checks, which must have caught up while a Backup leaves out Your files. provider: auto (Backblaze if installed), backblaze, or none. maxRemainingMB: how much may still be uploading.
confirm: The NAS has a snapshot from today.
_confirm: Extra lines for Test-WipeReady.ps1's "confirm yourself" list.
_linux: linux/restore-linux.sh. prefer: order of install sources (vendor = the vendor's own repo, package or installer; distro = apt/dnf/pacman; portable = AppImage or tarball; flatpak = Flathub). aur: auto (use yay/paru if installed), never. nodeMajor: Node.js major version for the NodeSource repo.
